answer: Require each identity to lock an escalating bond: 20 POA for 14 days for the first account, but any further account funded within two hops of the same source must lock double: 40, 80, 160 POA. That makes an ocean of clones exponentially expensive, not linearly. Funds stay locked through 8 payout epochs, and release needs attestations from 5 of 7 rotating verifiers, including one raven auditor who re-checks funding links at the epoch's zenith checkpoint. Linked accounts acting in lockstep lose 50% of each bond, so every added sybil risks a larger, longer lockup.
